ballistics.basis: Provisional game calibration, not historical firing data. Linear k=0.5*1.225*0.25*area*muzzleSpeed/mass; no Mach curve. Angular/speed sigmas are estimated, capped at 3 sigma; no salvo correlation or rangefinder error. Legacy penetrationMm retained at 5000 m, 10 m launch/sea target, nominal speed (637.693 m/s); see assets/parts/calibrate-penetration.ts. Residual budget follows speed^1.4, including descent recovery; armor resistance paid separately.

ap.basis: Provisional AP game calibration, not historical fuze/filler data. Arming requires caliber/6 equivalent resistance in one non-ricochet contact; delay 35 ms at >=200 mm, otherwise 20 ms; fill 2.5% of projectile mass; fragment budget 8% of caliber in mm. Smaller AA AP remains inert. See assets/parts/author-ap.ts; blast radius and damage are bounded approximations.

he.basis: Provisional HE game calibration, not historical shell/stock data. Contact burst; fill 8% of nominal projectile mass, fragment budget caliber/6 in mm, burst damage twice the AP catalog value. 40% HE stock rounded down per barrel. Shares the gun nominal launch mass/speed/drag envelope as an approximation. See assets/parts/author-he.ts.

accuracy.exterior: Original reconstruction against approved GameModels3D Hull A at 15 metres per source unit and source Y=0 waterline. Fine fittings and weathering are simplified; historical loading and year are unverified.
accuracy.internals: Estimated game envelopes for alternating machinery spaces, magazines, four shaft drives and steering; not a recovered historical internal plan.
accuracy.weapons: Approved Hull A armament uses original articulated builders and CPU installation-clearance interlocks. Performance, armor and interlock envelopes are provisional game values, not verified historical mechanical stops.

propulsion.basis: Provisional four-shaft cruiser game layout with alternating boiler/turbine spaces and equal drive shares. Internal boundaries, routing and machinery dimensions are estimates; the approved exterior reference does not verify them.

structuralPlating.note: Provisional game steel thicknesses; no historically verified plating schedule.

stability.basis: Estimated loading: dry CG calibrated to an initial GM of 7% beam; longitudinal CG matches modeled buoyancy at reference waterline. Uniform buoyancy scale reconciles stated mass with the authored hull volume. Outer shell uses the blueprint structural plating thickness. Residual flood cells conservatively exclude retained room boxes; partitions, permeability and access are game estimates.

localDamage.basis: Original game calibration: eight longitudinal sections, independent sides and three height bands, with separate gunhouse budgets. Generator/director proxy positions and fire loads are estimated; no historical structural tolerance, electrical routing, ventilation or crew-performance claim.

mountClearance.basis: Provisional CPU motion interlocks derived from the independently authored geometry and inspected source contacts. Capsule envelopes include the full recoil stroke; main gunhouse boxes include their rear hatch and roof fittings. Platform prisms include the visible bulwarks. These are game clearance envelopes, not verified historical mechanical stops.

damageControl.basis: Provisional game calibration shared across presets: three abstract teams, six-second setup, finite normalized fuel and spares. Repairs stop at 60% and cannot revive destroyed equipment. Small-hole shoring and portable pumps require accessible spaces. Flash-path attenuation is estimated; no individual crew, ventilation or electrical network.
